label: sdc02_4kings_d_04_dragonbb_01
text: 嗯～\n差不多就在这儿吧～[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_04_dragonbb_03
text: 我好像只从\n对战场外面见过。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_04_dragonbb_04
text: 像这样和你正面交锋\n还是第一次呢～[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_04_dragonbb_05
text: 蓝莓联盟……[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]哥姐们你\n要是赢不了呀～我就头疼了。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_04_dragonbb_06
text: 很头疼……\n非常～头疼！[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_04_dragonbb_07
text: ……但话虽这么说。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_04_dragonbb_08
text: 要是现在放水的话，\n我的乐子就没了。\r\n所以我也会拿出点干劲的。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_04_dragonbb_09
text: ……不过！\n也不需要搞得那么严肃。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_04_dragonbb_10
text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]你\n只要像平常一样对战就行啦。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_04_dragonbb_11
text: 阿若我觉得啊～\n非常兴奋哦。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_04_dragonbb_12
text: 那好～\n我们差不多开始吧～[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_04_dragonbb_13
text: 一起玩个痛快吧，[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]哥姐们！[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_04_dragonbb_14
text: 嘿嘿嘿！\n真是太痛快啦～[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_04_dragonbb_15
text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]……\n真高兴我拉[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]哥姐们你进了联盟社～[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_04_dragonbb_16
text: 既然你打赢了我呀～\n那就得正式入社才行啊！\r\n对吧！？没问题吧～！？[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_04_dragonbb_17
text: 嘿嘿嘿！\n真爽快！[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_04_dragonbb_18
text: 别小里小气的啦！\n你虽然嘴上这么说，\r\n其实内心……对吧～！？[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_04_dragonbb_19
text: 那好～我们来拍一下\n社员名册用的照片吧～！[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_04_dragonbb_20
text: ……照片拍得太胡闹，\n感觉要挨紫竽的骂了。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_04_dragonbb_21
text: 好像……还有点什么来着。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_04_dragonbb_22
text: 要送招式学习器\n给打败四天王的家伙来着？[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_04_dragonbb_23
text: 我没带在身上，\n稍微等我一下啊。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_04_clerk_npc
text: 恭喜你战胜\n四天王杜若！
